feedback: Accept. The RM faithfully encodes the task's ordering (ball out of the way -> key -> door open -> box) and is sound, reachable, and well-formed. Specifics: (1) Ordering and strictness: u0->u1 fires on blocker_moved; the u1->u2 conjunction `blocker_moved & has_door_key` correctly implements 'take the key only after the ball is out of the way' with blocker_moved read as the non-latching condition the environment defines — a key picked up while the ball was dropped back in front of the door does not progress until the ball is moved again and the key re-taken, which is achievable because the agent controls the drop location, so no compliant trajectory is permanently blocked. An early key pickup in u0 (before the ball moves) is correctly unrewarded and the later re-take is what earns reward, matching the environment note that the key may be picked up first and must be dropped. (2) Soundness of the tail: u2->u3 requires door_open and u3->u4 requires target_picked_up; since the door cannot be relocked and door_open can only first become true with the agent standing on the (now ball-free) cell before it, door_open cannot fire while blocker_moved is false, so no explicit regression transitions are needed — per-state else self-loops absorbing reverts of blocker_moved/has_door_key and the key_lost event keep the machine sound without them. target_picked_up is physically impossible before door_open, so the else loops in u0-u2 cannot be exploited. (3) Irrelevant events: key_lost and all condition reverts are absorbed by else self-loops in every state, as required. (4) Reachability: from every state the accepting state u4 is attainable (ball/key can always be repositioned; the door, once open, stays open), so there is no deadlock. (5) Rewards: progress rewards 0.1/0.2/0.3/1.0 are increasing, bounded (total 1.6), given only on ordered transitions; the machine is a forward DAG, so no reward-farming cycles exist, and the final 1.0 dominates the 0.6 of shaping. Verified against the seed-0 example trace: pickup ball (+0.1), drop away, pickup key (+0.2), toggle (+0.3), drop key (else; key_lost stays false with door open), pickup box (+1.0). (6) Format: header, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with per-state else self-loops, and REWARD_FUNCTION all follow the paper format; FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty with u4 declared in STATES and accepting (goal: target box carried). Predicate-only conditions are used; the event key_lost is appropriately left to else coverage.
